sentences.text: S1 stated that everything told to her is confidential and covered by legal privilege, and that she would make a note of the conversation.
S2 identified the alleged perpetrator as Brian Hollis, who ran the junior squad at Harbridge Swimming Club.
S2 stated he joined the club at age nine and became the junior squad coach at age eleven.
S2 disclosed that Brian Hollis touched him in the changing room after training when the other children had gone.
S2 disclosed that Brian Hollis made him touch Hollis, stating it was part of being in the squad and that everyone did it.
S2 stated the incidents occurred every Saturday morning after squad training.
S2 stated the abuse occurred from when he was eleven until he was nearly thirteen (approximately 1996 to 1998).
S2 stated he told his mother when he was 13, that she did not know what to do, and she took him out of the club.
S2 stated his mother did not report the abuse to anyone.
S2 stated he told his wife, Claire, in 2020.
S2 stated he saw his GP.
S2 stated he went to the police last year in March and gave them a statement.
S2 stated the police officer had interviewed Brian Hollis and the investigation was still ongoing.
S2 stated he heard Brian Hollis had done it to other boys.
S2 stated a lad who was in the squad messaged him on Facebook saying he had heard the same about a couple of others.
S2 stated he did not see anything happen to anyone else himself.
S2 stated he has had anxiety for years and panic attacks.
S2 stated he had counselling through work in 2021.
S2 stated he is currently working as a site manager.
S2 stated he had three months off sick in 2021.
S2 provided the police officer's name as DC Farrow.
S2 stated he has the sick notes from his time off sick.
S2 stated the counsellor wrote a letter for the police.
S2 stated his primary objectives were for the club to admit it let it happen, and for some money for counselling due to NHS waiting list issues.
S1 explained that normally there is a three-year time limit for personal injury claims, which for a child starts at eighteen.
S1 explained that in abuse cases the court can allow a claim to proceed outside the time limit, looking at why there was a delay and whether a fair trial is still possible.
S1 stated the claim could be against Mr Hollis himself and against the club if he was acting as their coach.
S1 stated they would usually act on a no win, no fee agreement.
S1 requested S2 send the crime reference, DC Farrow's details, the counsellor's letter, and the sick notes by Friday the 4th of December.
S1 stated she would request S2's GP records with his permission and would send a form for him to sign this week.
